dict.string: StorageLens indexes your Desktop so it can show where disk space is used.
StorageLens indexes your Documents folder so it can show where disk space is used.
StorageLens indexes your Downloads folder so it can show where disk space is used.
StorageLens reads removable volumes you choose to scan so it can show what they contain.
StorageLens reads network volumes you choose to scan so it can show what they contain.
